Audio log

Audio log

What the sound engine did, newest at the bottom. Kept when the app is closed, so a dropout can be screenshotted afterwards.

  

  
Send a report opens your mail app with the report to David - press Send. It holds this log, the app's build, the device and iOS version, and what the sound engine is doing now - no pieces, recordings or personal details.

Transitions

    
A row can end with a run of single notes that leads into the next
      chord — the pattern stands aside while it plays. Turning Motion on switches
      it on and turning Motion off switches it off; either way this switch decides.

  

  

    
Chord suggestions

    
Mild keeps to plain triads. Spicy lets sevenths, ninths
      and diminished chords in.

  

  





  
Breaks

  

    
Breaks

    
The jam keeps running underneath the silence. Hold your groove
      and come back in with it — the first beat of the break still sounds.

  

  

    
How long, how often

    

  

  

    
During the break

    
The click can keep the time for you, or leave you to it. The
      bass and the drums can carry on so you are playing against a band rather
      than into silence. The marker either walks the silent bars or waits on the
      last beat you heard.
